title: Dalio Says We’re Nearing Point Where AI Bubble May Burst
key_facts: Ray Dalio, Bridgewater founder, spoke at the Forbes Global CEO Conference in Singapore on Wednesday 7 Oct 2026.
He called AI a 'classic bubble' nearing a bursting point.
He cited debt taken on to fund AI and rising interest rates.
He named wealth taxes and efforts to convert unrealised gains into cash as other possible triggers.
Bond yields worldwide are at their highest in decades; S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 hit record highs this week.
quote_evidence: "We're in the part of the cycle that is before that but approaching that," the Bridgewater founder said.
why_it_matters_hint: A widely followed investor says debt and rising rates are pushing the AI boom toward a tipping point.
notes: Bloomberg blocked (403). Text read in The Edge Malaysia, which carries the Bloomberg report. Source credited to Bloomberg.
